comment.body:
Thanks for the screenshot and the restart checks; they establish the exact pairing-update error, but not which settings-sync check failed. #50795 and the open candidate #51789 cover one known signer-verification cause, so please do not repeat broad firewall changes just for this error.

- Comment `/bugreport` immediately after reproducing **New key** so the report captures the corresponding Settings/Mouse Without Borders rejection or exception.
- State whether **Use Service** is on and whether changing another Mouse Without Borders setting also fails.

Do not post the pairing/security key itself; it is not needed. This evidence will let us link the known signer case confidently or separate another failure without starting a competing fix.

fix_assessment.rationale: 50795/51789 are existing coverage for one plausible cause of this exact symptom; applicability to this report is conditional on the requested rejection evidence, not asserted as confirmed.
